edit.deferral: The Commerce Office put off my repair. Its ruling: "FIGURES MAY BE GIVEN FROM MEMORY. THE TERMINAL IS OPTIONAL."

short: A supply pod hit the library annex, and the Throughput Subcommittee shelved my repair for a door.
question: Your bosses have ruled you may give figures from memory. So what was revenue in 2193?
reply: I don't give figures from memory. I read them from the terminal. I looked up revenue by quarter, all genres, for every quarter it holds. Together they come to $695,243.61.
